mapper.select: SELECT R.RESUME_ID, COALESCE(U.USER_NUM, R.USER_NUM) AS USER_NUM, R.TITLE, COALESCE(R.USER_NM, U.USER_NM) AS USER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(R.BIRTH_DATE, U.BIRTH_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d') AS BIRTH_DATE, R.GENDER, COALESCE(R.USER_PHONE, U.USER_PHONE) AS USER_PHONE, COALESCE(R.USER_EMAIL, U.USER_EMAIL) AS USER_EMAIL, R.ADDRESS_FIRST, R.ADDRESS_SECOND, U.USER_PHOTO_NAME, U.USER_PHOTO_PATH, U.USER_ID, U.KAKAO_ID, U.USER_MEMBER_TYPE, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, U.BIRTH_DATE, CURDATE()) AS AGE FROM HIRE_USER U LEFT JOIN RESUME R ON U.USER_NUM = R.USER_NUM WHERE U.USER_NUM = #{userNum}
